UpgradeExpiredRecoveryColdHandbackIntent.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoveryColdHandbackIntent

UpgradeExpiredRecoveryColdPairCommand.description: New qualification dispatch; cannot reuse an interrupted original command.
UpgradeExpiredRecoveryColdPairCommand.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoveryColdPairCommand

UpgradeExpiredRecoveryColdPairResult.description: Actual new worker result retained even when it fails exact-pair qualification.
UpgradeExpiredRecoveryColdPairResult.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoveryColdPairResult

UpgradeExpiredRecoveryColdResolution.description: Linked late recovery, retaining original upgrade failure and history.
UpgradeExpiredRecoveryColdResolution.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoveryColdResolution

UpgradeExpiredRecoveryColdSmokeCommand.description: Registry-bound Source probe in a distinct recovery ownership namespace.
UpgradeExpiredRecoveryColdSmokeCommand.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoveryColdSmokeCommand

UpgradeExpiredRecoveryColdSourceIntent.description: Write-ahead exact Source projection, preserving all old authority history.
UpgradeExpiredRecoveryColdSourceIntent.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoveryColdSourceIntent

UpgradeExpiredRecoveryColdSourceLaunch.description: One fixed Source-node spawn intent; no arbitrary argv or caller deadline.
UpgradeExpiredRecoveryColdSourceLaunch.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoveryColdSourceLaunch

UpgradeExpiredRecoveryColdSourceProcess.description: Positive owned process identity only; never application/serving readiness.
UpgradeExpiredRecoveryColdSourceProcess.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoveryColdSourceProcess

UpgradeExpiredRecoveryColdVerification.description: Core-produced bounded verification; handback and release remain separate.
UpgradeExpiredRecoveryColdVerification.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoveryColdVerification

UpgradeExpiredRecoveryConsumptionCheck.description: Fixed-node callback bindings only; no URL, credentials or effect argv.
UpgradeExpiredRecoveryConsumptionCheck.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoveryConsumptionCheck

UpgradeExpiredRecoveryConsumptionDeliver.description: Fixed delivery request; no paths, deadlines or credential fields.
UpgradeExpiredRecoveryConsumptionDeliver.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoveryConsumptionDeliveryRead

UpgradeExpiredRecoveryConsumptionState.description: Fresh pending/consumed delivery state, never inferred from an error.
UpgradeExpiredRecoveryConsumptionState.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoveryConsumptionState

UpgradeExpiredRecoveryDataSnapshot.description: Core-produced data fingerprints only; no private records in the wire shape.
UpgradeExpiredRecoveryDataSnapshot.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoveryDataSnapshot

UpgradeExpiredRecoveryIntent.description: Immutable server-captured intent; effect authorization remains separate.
UpgradeExpiredRecoveryIntent.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoveryIntent

UpgradeExpiredRecoveryLegacyService.description: Positive managed-service observation; not ownership transfer or cleanup.
UpgradeExpiredRecoveryLegacyService.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoveryLegacyService

UpgradeExpiredRecoveryLegacyStopIntent.description: Persist before a fixed legacy stop; never proof that stop occurred.
UpgradeExpiredRecoveryLegacyStopIntent.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoveryLegacyStopIntent

UpgradeExpiredRecoveryLegacyStopReceipt.description: Verified fixed service stop; not new ownership or complete physical cleanup.
UpgradeExpiredRecoveryLegacyStopReceipt.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoveryLegacyStopReceipt

UpgradeExpiredRecoveryLegacyStopReconcil.description:
Fresh observed retirement, never an invented bootout acknowledgement.

Producer must independently verify kernel exclusion, authority, actual legacy
identity absence, service unload and exact Source preservation. DTO alone is
neither ownership nor cleanup/serving qualification.
UpgradeExpiredRecoveryLegacyStopReconcil.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoveryLegacyStopReconciliation

UpgradeExpiredRecoveryNativeDataSnapshot.description: Native fixed-store content fingerprints, with no private filenames/content.
UpgradeExpiredRecoveryNativeDataSnapshot.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoveryNativeDataSnapshot

UpgradeExpiredRecoveryObservation.description:
Passive retained metadata; not Source-serving or cleanup qualification.

Producers must independently verify installed observer bytes and authenticate
transport. Consumers must check freshness and recheck live Core authority.
UpgradeExpiredRecoveryObservation.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoveryObservation

UpgradeExpiredRecoveryOwnerCheck.description: Fixed-node fresh owner callback; no caller deadline or target URL.
UpgradeExpiredRecoveryOwnerCheck.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoveryOwnerCheck

UpgradeExpiredRecoveryOwnerClaim.description:
Claim evidence, not proof by DTO shape; producer must hold kernel exclusion.

Actual process/module/bytes, positive retirement, authenticated current Core
scope and Source preservation must be verified before retaining this record.
Maintenance/serving/qualification cannot be inferred from claim publication.
UpgradeExpiredRecoveryOwnerClaim.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoveryOwnerClaim

UpgradeExpiredRecoveryOwnerState.description:
Fresh accepted/unaccepted result, never infer from generic failure.

An unaccepted observation is not an effect grant; initial transfer gates
remain mandatory. Accepted state still requires actual lifetime ownership.
UpgradeExpiredRecoveryOwnerState.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoveryOwnerState

UpgradeExpiredRecoveryOwnerTransfer.description:
Retain before handover; not an authenticated effect grant or completion.

Producers must reauthorize the admin, verify both process identities and
exclusive kernel/launchd ownership, retain fences and consume once durably.
UpgradeExpiredRecoveryOwnerTransfer.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoveryOwnerTransfer

UpgradeExpiredRecoveryRequest.description:
Optimistic bindings and catalog ID only; server captures the new epoch.

Original deadlines, effect argv, artifact paths and peer credentials cannot
be caller fields. Acceptance must resolve the retained plan/scopes and the
immutable support release, authenticate/admin-audit and pin ownership before
producing any execution authority. This request itself grants none.
UpgradeExpiredRecoveryRequest.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoveryRequest

UpgradeExpiredRecoveryStatus.description: Durable administrative inspection; no executable owner capability.
UpgradeExpiredRecoveryStatus.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoveryStatus

UpgradeExpiredRecoverySuccessionDelivery.description: Fixed passive successor inspection, never a caller destination or authority.
UpgradeExpiredRecoverySuccessionDelivery.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoverySuccessionDeliveryRead

UpgradeExpiredRecoverySuccessionDelivery.description: Explicit pending/grant result; neither grants native effect permission.
UpgradeExpiredRecoverySuccessionDelivery.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoverySuccessionDeliveryState

UpgradeExpiredRecoverySuccessionGrant.description:
Audited scope DTO, not lifetime ownership or permission by shape alone.

Core must separately reauthorize admin and persist this exact captured window.
Neither replay nor crash may change the original intent's recovery deadline.
UpgradeExpiredRecoverySuccessionGrant.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoverySuccessionGrant

UpgradeExpiredRecoverySuccessionObservat.description:
Same-kernel crash preconditions, not a new grant or absence-based takeover.

A separately authenticated/audited succession protocol must capture authority
before effects. Changed boot requires its own supported fresh Source protocol.
UpgradeExpiredRecoverySuccessionObservat.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoverySuccessionObservation

UpgradeExpiredRecoverySuccessorClaim.description:
Distinct successor preimage: shape alone is never kernel ownership.

A trusted producer must retain the actual lifetime exclusion capability and
repeat fresh Core/physical gates. The original consumption is preserved,
never rewritten to make the successor look like the initial consumer.
UpgradeExpiredRecoverySuccessorClaim.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoverySuccessorClaim

UpgradeExpiredRecoverySuccessorState.description: Positive authenticated inspection, never error-based initial fallback.
UpgradeExpiredRecoverySuccessorState.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoverySuccessorState

UpgradeExpiredRecoverySupportContextRead.description: Fixed startup context read; no caller paths, budgets or credentials.
UpgradeExpiredRecoverySupportContextRead.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoverySupportContextRead

UpgradeExpiredRecoverySupportProcess.description: Verified passive support identity, not serving or transferred ownership.
UpgradeExpiredRecoverySupportProcess.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoverySupportProcess

UpgradeExpiredRecoveryTransferConsumptio.description:
Core-produced one-time consumption evidence, not completed native handover.

Receiving a structurally valid receipt is insufficient: transport and durable
Core/local provenance, current admin authority and physical ownership must be
verified by producers. No receipt changes original deadlines or fencing.
UpgradeExpiredRecoveryTransferConsumptio.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoveryTransferConsumption

UpgradeExpiredRecoveryUnstartedObservati.description: Retired startup and retained original preimages; no cleanup/serving claim.
UpgradeExpiredRecoveryUnstartedObservati.title: UpgradeExpiredRecoveryUnstartedObservation

UpgradeMigrationExecution.description: A consumed migration attempt is never permission to run the schema change twice.
UpgradeMigrationExecution.title: UpgradeMigrationExecution

UpgradeMigrationNotStarted.description: An authoritative execution fence, distinct from a completed migration.
UpgradeMigrationNotStarted.title: UpgradeMigrationNotStarted

UpgradeRecoveryRetiredSupervisor.description: Fixed private fixture supervisor preimage; not permission from absence.
UpgradeRecoveryRetiredSupervisor.title: UpgradeRecoveryRetiredSupervisor

UpgradeRecoverySchemaRequest.description: Prepare only the known pre-recovery 0034 shape; no caller SQL or budget.
UpgradeRecoverySchemaRequest.title: UpgradeRecoverySchemaRequest

UpgradeReleaseSummary.description: Public release metadata excludes executor configuration and private mount paths.
UpgradeReleaseSummary.title: UpgradeReleaseSummary
